_README: THIS REPO'S OWN deferral registry — not loom's, not the template's. Record here any enforcement this repo DEFERRED (a detector not built, a probe not authored, a gate left advisory) so the SessionStart surface can count it and it cannot rot unseen. One entry per deferral, keyed '<rule-id>#<clause>', each carrying at minimum: reason, graduation (the condition that retires it), expires (ISO YYYY-MM-DD), accepted_by (a NAMED human, never an agent), and risk (one of security | trust | process | hygiene). An entry with no readable 'expires' is counted separately as UNDATED and reported as past due, because an undated deferral never ages out. Keys beginning '_' are metadata and are never counted. Deleting this file does not clear the backlog — it makes the backlog unreadable, which the surface reports as NOT VERIFIED, never as empty. Obligation: rules/deferral-registry-locality.md. DURABILITY WARNING, read before you rely on this file: `/sync-from-template` is a category-based REPLACE, not a per-file merge, and files at the `.claude/` root are outside the set `bin/sync-preflight-local-mods.mjs` scans — so a future pull can overwrite rows you recorded here, whole, with no warning and no conflict marker. This is NOT reachable today (no consumer carries a registry yet, so there is nothing to overwrite), and the mechanism fix — declaring this path consumer-owned so the pull preserves it — is tracked as loom#1729 and is a prerequisite of the distribution wave. Until #1729 lands, treat a row here as recoverable from git history rather than as the only copy, and check `git status` after any `/sync-from-template`.
